# Thunderbird Calendar read-dialog positioning and shared source loading

Always invoke `PositionedDialog` positioning: `getIdealDialogPosition` already centers when the trigger is missing or invisible. In `CalendarDialog.show()`, choose visible `#calendarDisplayBox`, otherwise `#tabpanelcontainer`, then `document.documentElement`, so inactive-Calendar launches center in visible application chrome. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
